callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to a directory that may contain a code indexing database.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized with the project's code index when the project can be indexed; returns a falsy value when indexing is not possible (e.g., database missing or incompatible).

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_function_spans
callees.pre_condition: The receiver is an initialized CodeGraphExtractor instance. language is a language key string (e.g., 'java'). filepath is an absolute path to a source file in the project.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of (func_name: str, start_idx: int, end_idx: int) tuples for all functions defined in the file — start_idx and end_idx are 0-indexed inclusive line numbers. Returns None or a falsy value when the file is not present in the index.
